name: Nine Titans
description: Nine planeswalkers who piloted huge artifact Titan Engines built by Urza to attack Phyrexia.

description_citations.text: "Urza". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bo Levar and the Titans capture the caves at Koilos.
timeline.quote: Bo Levar assaulted and captured the caves at Koilos

citation.text: "Bo Levar", section "Nine Titans". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Levar leads the last Titans to plant the bombs and destroy Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: Levar led the last titans to plant the bombs and destroy the plane .

citation.text: "Bo Levar", section "Nine Titans". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Freyalise returns to defend Dominaria as one of Urza's Nine Titans.
timeline.quote: Freyalise returned to defend Dominaria against the Phyrexian Invasion as one of Urza's Nine Titans

citation.text: "Freyalise", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza leads the Nine Titans in a counter-attack on Phyrexia; Tevesh Szat betrays and kills Daria, and Urza kills him, sealing him in a soul bomb.
timeline.quote: Urza activated the rubrik and killed Szat, sealing him in a Soul bomb

citation.text: "Phyrexia", section "Counter attack and betrayal". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Nine Titans counterattack Phyrexia directly; several are killed and Urza defects to Yawgmoth.
timeline.quote: Urza defected to the side of Yawgmoth

citation.text: "Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria", section "Second stage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The remaining Nine Titans gut Phyrexia, wrecking its first seven spheres.
timeline.quote: the first seven spheres of Phyrexia were wrecked

citation.text: "Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria", section "Final stage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Taysir is recruited among the Nine Titans for the attack on Phyrexia, with Daria taking Teferi's place and Urza insisting on Szat.
timeline.quote: Taysir was one of the Nine Titans recruited by Urza to participate in the attack on Phyrexia.

citation.text: "Taysir of Rabiah", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The remaining Nine Titans set off the last Soul Bomb, gutting Phyrexia, but Yawgmoth has already left and arrives on Dominaria as a death cloud.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth finally comes back to Dominaria, after 9000 years, in the form of a death cloud

citation.text: "Apocalypse (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza's Nine Titans enter Phyrexia, but Tevash Szat betrays and kills his fellow planeswalkers until Urza defeats him and uses his life force for soul bombs.
timeline.quote: Tevash Szat began to betray and kill his fellow planeswalkers, turning to the side of the Phyrexians.

citation.text: "Urza", section "Betrayal". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On Theros, the gods battle the titans and seal them in the Underworld, where they remain until they break free.
timeline.quote: The gods of Theros battled them and sealed them away in the Underworld, where they remained until they broke free.

citation.text: "Giant", section "Titans". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The gods, born from mortal prayer, seal the titans away in the Underworld with Klothys as eternal jailer.
timeline.quote: the gods sealed the titans away in the Underworld

citation.text: "Theros (plane)", section "The sealing of the titans". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Klothys leaves the Underworld, leaving the titans unguarded for the first time in millennia.
timeline.quote: leaving the titans unguarded for the first time in millennia.

citation.text: "War of the Gods", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Long ago the titans are sealed in the Underworld and Klothys volunteers as their eternal jailer.
timeline.quote: it was Klothys who volunteered to serve as their eternal jailer.

citation.text: "Klothys", section "The binding of the titans". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Klothys and Kruphix war against the titans and seal them in the Underworld with Klothys watching.
timeline.quote: Victorious, the twin gods sealed the Titans in the Underworld with Klothys to keep watch.

citation.text: "Underworld", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
